people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

people.name: Sinai
people.line: Mountain where Moses received the Ten Commandments

people.name: Sinai_Wilderness
people.line: Wilderness where Israel camped after leaving Egypt

translations.web: which Yahweh commanded Moses in Mount Sinai in the day that he commanded the children of Israel to offer their offerings to Yahweh, in the wilderness of Sinai.
translations.bsb: which the LORD gave Moses on Mount Sinai on the day He commanded the Israelites to present their offerings to the LORD in the Wilderness of Sinai.
translations.kjv: Which the LORD commanded Moses in mount Sinai, in the day that he commanded the children of Israel to offer their oblations unto the LORD, in the wilderness of Sinai.
translations.asv: which Jehovah commanded Moses in mount Sinai, in the day that he commanded the children of Israel to offer their oblations unto Jehovah, in the wilderness of Sinai.
